decisive_finding.reproduction: A self-consistent attacker-marketplace observation and expectation for the canonical package, version, home, tree, context, and candidate promoted into the canonical journey.

decisive_finding.impact: Caller-selected marketplace provenance can be laundered into a package- and journey-bound cache identity.

Require CacheSnapshot marketplace equality with the bound journey before cache SurfaceIdentity construction.
Add a self-consistent wrong-marketplace negative and rerun the full package identity review.
